_about: THE LIVE TRUST SET (S-5, WO-6). A source input, fixed into the production-channel artifact at build time.
It holds exactly the entry the Director's WO-6 revision 5 records: the public key of the Factory-managed release signer, which the
live plane generated in the founder's bootstrap (2026-10-04) and the Director read from the plane. No person holds or handles its
private key, and it is never a key the implementer generated or holds. A replaced signer is a new WO-6 revision and a new candidate.
Each entry: { "key_id": "ed25519:<sha256 of the 32-byte public key, hex>", "public_key": "<32-byte Ed25519 public key, base64url>" }.
